about: Everything of Garry's Mod a player could see or hear, and how this mashup keeps it out of sight (the user asked that only Katamari and SILENT HILL 2 show). hideable = no rows are told to the user and stated on the listing.

element.about: what of Garry's Mod would show

how.about: how it is hidden or replaced

rows.element: Spawn menu (Q), context menu (C), Physics Gun, Tool Gun, undo
rows.how: Own gamemode derived from base, not sandbox: none of these exist.

rows.element: Default weapons and their view models
rows.how: PlayerLoadout gives nothing; PreDrawViewModel returns true.

rows.element: Health, suit, ammo, crosshair, weapon selection, damage indicators, pickup history, hints, zoom, geiger, train/vehicle, squad, poison, chat box
rows.how: HUDShouldDraw returns false for each CHud element in hud_elements; HUDDrawPickupHistory and HUDDrawTargetID do nothing.
PlayerBindPress blocks messagemode/messagemode2; CHudChat hidden; ChatText returns true.
ScoreboardShow/ScoreboardHide do nothing and return false.

rows.element: Noclip (V), flashlight (F), sprays (T), suicide (kill), use (E), zoom (B), jump/crouch
rows.how: PlayerNoClip, PlayerSwitchFlashlight, PlayerSpray, CanPlayerSuicide return false/true to block; control system strips the keys.

rows.element: The Garry's Mod player model and its shadow
rows.how: Player is SetNoDraw and not solid; James is drawn instead.

rows.element: Garry's Mod main menu shown as the pause menu (Esc)
rows.how: OnPauseMenuShow returns false and our pause menu opens; Esc again closes it. Garry's Mod's own rules: holding SHIFT with Esc still opens its menu, and after four blocked Esc presses in a short time it shows a note on how to do that (OnPauseMenuBlockedTooManyTimes runs in the menu realm, out of a gamemode's reach). The quit button is left out if Garry's Mod blocks Lua from running 'quit' (IsConCommandBlocked).
Launched with +sv_loadingurl pointing at our loading.html via asset://.

rows.element: Garry's Mod main menu for a moment at startup, before the map starts loading
rows.how: Started with +map so it goes straight to loading; it can't be removed without editing base files (not allowed).
PostDraw2DSkyBox paints the 2D sky with the fog colour (gm_flatgrass has no 3D skybox, so PreDrawSkyBox is never called there); on maps with a 3D skybox PreDrawSkyBox clears it and returns true.
A ground plane covers the floor; fog end is far shorter than the distance to any wall; the stage stays in the middle.

rows.element: Half-Life 2 impact and scrape sounds from props
rows.how: EntityEmitSound drops every entity sound that is not a sounds-sheet id or a converted file. The default_silent physics material alone is not enough: it inherits the impact sounds of 'default' (Garry's Mod surfaceproperties.txt).
Katamari's font from the player's copy when found; otherwise a system font, never a Garry's Mod one.
No errors (preflight, luacheck, real-run log check).

rows.element: Window title 'Garry's Mod' and the taskbar icon

rows.how: Not changeable; Melty starts Garry's Mod.

rows.element: Melty page lists Garry's Mod as a required game
rows.how: Required by Melty: players must own Garry's Mod.
